# Execution Guide (20 Jan 2026)

- Best entries: 09:00–09:30 (continuation) or 10:00–11:00 (pullback-resume).  
- Entry discipline: Use limit orders; if gap >3% at open, wait for pullback; consider split entries (50% + 50%).  
- Exits:  
  - Hit target (+5%): sell immediately.  
  - Hit stop (-2%): exit immediately.  
  - Day 3 close (22 Jan): close positions regardless of status.

# Risk Management

- Max 25% per stock; max 3 stocks at once.  
- Always apply -2% stop loss (no exceptions).  
- Keep 25% cash reserve.  
- No averaging down; move on quickly.

# Daily Checklist

- Morning: Check suspensions and news; set limit orders.  
- During day: Monitor each 1–2 hours; adjust stops; take profits at +5%.  
- End of day: Record trades; review P&L; plan next day.
